content:
Hi!

With Fable's help, I generated comprehensive Lean bindings for SDL3, and made a cross-platform UI library on top of that.

I've used and tested part of the libraries (on Mac M4) for a few weeks, and found no major issues so far. But if you run into bugs or nonsensical APIs, don't hesitate to file them or send pull requests. These libraries are also meant to be usable by humans :blush:
@Phil Nguyen nice to see someone carry my torch lol
Btw I added an issue on the repo about SDL GPU examples
